tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support a coupled transient mechanism, but the five pilot rows leave its five parameters underidentified. The trajectory batch provides the observations needed to fit and test that mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations are insufficient to distinguish the coupled parameters reliably; the mechanism note calls for at least eight rows.
These static models do not account for the observed coupled transient lag.
It does not target the identified parameter ambiguity.
